product_constraint: 1.5x–3x same-request committed Decode with drafts 2/3, exact target state/logits and original independent numerical baseline

downward_budget.authority: Old v7 family attribution is a ceiling, not current matched v31 latency or a projected gain; PV alone cannot close the full gap.

mechanism: Remove the shared V/probability producer, copy ring and CTA barriers. One 128-thread CTA owns one full query-head output; each lane retains the original two output accumulators. Four independent raw position records are prefetched in registers with read-only global loads. Adjacent speculative-row/head CTAs may reuse immutable KV through cache, with no cache correctness assumption.

equivalence.original: For each row/head/dimension: a=+0; for s=0..actual_sequence-1: a=fma.rn.f32(P[s],FP32(BF16(V[s,d])),a); publish RNE_BF16(a).
equivalence.candidate: Identical ordered recurrence and publication. Only immutable operand loads and independent-output ownership change. No padded/future position enters an FMA; each row uses its actual causal length and original probability stride.
equivalence.unchanged: QK, softmax, projection, draft, recurrence, immutable snapshots, state/logit publication, failures, startup inventory and reserve.

trade: Old 16*M CTAs of six warps share a V tile across heads; new 24*M CTAs of four warps have the same 96*M total warps and no shared allocation/barriers. Global V reads are repeated across six heads; cache reuse is a hypothesis, and read traffic/latency may outweigh deleted materialization. No hardware-stall or gain claim from source alone.
reference_translation: Previously studied FlashInfer grouped-query KV reuse and existing SM87 ordered Attention expose shared producer/consumer ownership. This alternative removes that boundary rather than enlarging shared KV as in rejected v19. Native CUDA read-only loads and registers only; no imported code or dependency. vLLM/Marlin projections and FLA/Mamba recurrence stay unchanged.

selection.minimum_admission: Build/static no-spill review, full P513 prefix/state/logit/transaction/recovery and P8192 complete prefix comparison against scalar on identical history.
selection.api: Immediate same P65/8K/40K d2 API/lifecycle panel versus frozen v31/non-MTP, all Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total and work counts. Short P65 is unaffected sanity only. Greater-than-3% long-context Decode regression stops; neutral/negative removes. Useful direction unlocks d3.
selection.expiry: Useful dependency only through next complete verifier API return or archival; no launch/prefetch/cache/grid scan or qualification-only campaign.

resources: No new allocation or arena/sidecar; all prior capacity and 8-GiB startup reserve gates remain.
production: Unchanged installed non-MTP service; admission only
